name: onion
description: The admin app's document for this box's Tor and I2P addresses. The onion surface's API routes are lososd's own handlers on the second listener (LOSOS_ONION_PORT, modules/daemon.nix); this plugin hands out the one page the API is not: the app's index.html, which the browser renders (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-09-csr-offload-design.md, part B). It never names a caller: whoever reaches it, the page it serves is the same.
